verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of acting on many items at once is New Relic Agent Control with Terraform, which the docs describe as a declarative way to manage fleets of agents at scale. It is limited to agent fleets and requires Terraform. Entity search and CLI tag management are search or single-item operations, not bulk actions. Missing for 10: general bulk operations across entities, alerts and dashboards; batch CLI or API mutation commands; AI or MCP-driven bulk actions; hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: New Relic Agent Control with Terraform provides a powerful, declarative solution for managing fleets of agents at scale.
